name: Mujahid v. Daniels
summary: The Ninth Circuit held that a prisoner's challenge to the denial of good-time credits, which would affect the duration of confinement, was properly brought as a habeas corpus petition under § 2241.
significance: This Ninth Circuit decision addressed whether a prisoner's challenge to the loss of good-time credits could proceed through § 2241 habeas, and is cited as part of the circuit split on whether claims affecting early release can be brought in habeas.
